verdict.rationale: The instructions are public: justica.gov.pt lays out the steps, the authentication options, the foreign-founder route and the exact fees, all readable without logging in. The forms themselves are not shown to be downloadable. Using the service requires Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital or eIDAS authentication, and the pacto social is generated automatically inside the platform rather than offered as a template. The published eportugal.gov.pt entry path also returns 404. Missing for 10: downloadable blank forms or pre-approved pact models available without an account, downloadable instruction documents (e.g. PDF guides) rather than web text, and a working eportugal entry URL.
